rowsHeld.reason: Child-facing gate refuses the stem on house vocabulary: "poorly" in the sentence hits the banned-vocabulary rule '"poor" (voice)', pattern \bpoor(ly)?\b (packages/core/src/banned-vocabulary.json). Reword (e.g. 'When I felt ill'), do not exempt. On merit the row is otherwise sound: DOC+TOR = DOCTOR fits 'at the surgery' and is the only fit; FAC+TOR = FACTOR and EDI+TOR = EDITOR are real words that do not fit, so both existing executions are true of the row.
